note: Split the count->probability conversion level by whether a book priced the player, with a rail against a failed market join. Fitted on priced players and served to everyone, the board summed to 4.60 expected scorers/game against 4.28 actual over 570 held-out games; all of it the players no book quoted, published at 4.8% each against a true 0.41%. Unpriced level fits to 0.07 by log loss and 0.074 by calibration. Held-out 2025 aggregate +8.1% -> -0.5%, priced rows byte-identical. min_priced_share 0.411 (half the fitted median) refuses the split when the market join returns an implausible share.
